overview: Chips: Broadcom lines up a $60 billion financing package to supply AI chips for Anthropic's compute buildout.
Big story: Trump creates a 'Super Intelligence Force' led by DNI Jay Clayton to steer federal AI policy.

items.headline: Trump creates 'Super Intelligence Force' to steer AI policy
items.summary: President Trump named Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to chair a new federal task force on AI, with FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Pentagon's Emil Michael and OPM's Scott Kupor as vice chairs. The group has 120 days to define the government's role in AI development.

items.headline: DeepSeek gains narrow US lead over China in AI
items.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence found top Chinese AI models now trail US rivals by just 3% on benchmark scores, down from about 9% in May, after DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash release. The shrinking gap challenges assumptions that export controls would preserve a lasting US AI advantage.

items.headline: Broadcom lines up $60 billion AI chip financing for Anthropic
items.summary: Broadcom's banking syndicate is assembling roughly $60 billion in financing, including a $42 billion senior-secured tranche, to help fund Anthropic's leasing of Broadcom's custom AI chips. The size of the debt package shows how AI compute buildouts are increasingly financed off-balance-sheet rather than from cash reserves.

items.headline: Amazon pledges $1 billion to communities near AI data centers
items.summary: Amazon said it will spend more than $1 billion over five years on programs for communities near its data centers, as AWS chief Matt Garman defended the construction boom. Garman also said AWS has stopped signing NDAs with government agencies during site approvals, responding to local backlash.

items.headline: TSMC weighs multibillion-dollar Texas campus for AI chips
items.summary: TSMC is considering a new chipmaking campus in Texas that would add tens of billions of dollars to its US expansion, according to Taiwan's Economic Daily News. The move would deepen the world's largest contract chipmaker's bet on US-based production as AI chip demand keeps surging.

items.headline: Nvidia board adds $150 billion to buyback program
items.summary: Nvidia's board authorized an additional $150 billion for share repurchases, lifting its total remaining buyback authorization to $235 billion. The move signals confidence in sustained AI chip demand even as Nvidia commits massive capital to data-center and model-maker partnerships.

items.headline: Stargate expands with five new AI data center sites
items.summary: OpenAI, Oracle and SoftBank announced five additional Stargate data center sites as part of their joint US AI infrastructure build-out. The expansion adds to the project's existing capacity as the partners race to secure power and compute for OpenAI's growing workloads.

items.headline: Broadcom extends Meta partnership on custom AI chips
items.summary: Broadcom announced an extended, multi-generational partnership with Meta to deploy technology supporting multiple gigawatts of Meta's custom MTIA silicon. The deal builds on the companies' existing collaboration and underscores Meta's push to reduce reliance on merchant GPU suppliers for AI training and inference.

items.headline: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 opens ChatGPT as agent platform
items.summary: At DevDay 2026, OpenAI introduced agents that can take on ongoing responsibilities and said it is opening ChatGPT as a shared surface where people and AI agents collaborate. OpenAI said ChatGPT now reaches 1.2 billion weekly users, underscoring the platform's scale as it pushes deeper into agentic AI.

items.headline: AWS unveils trio of new AI strategy announcements
items.summary: At its 'What's Next with AWS' event, AWS launched Amazon Quick, an AI work assistant, and expanded Amazon Connect into agentic AI tools for supply chain, hiring and customer experience. AWS also said it is bringing OpenAI's GPT-5.5 and Codex models to Amazon Bedrock in limited preview.

items.headline: DeepSeek and Huawei chip away at Nvidia's AI moat
items.summary: DeepSeek and Huawei have released open-source Ascend AI programming tools to cut reliance on Nvidia's CUDA software ecosystem, Bloomberg Opinion reports. The tools could make it easier for Chinese AI firms still dependent on American hardware to shift to homegrown chips over time.

items.headline: Researchers find censorship built into Alibaba's Qwen AI model
items.summary: Israeli cybersecurity startup Hirundo found that Alibaba's open-weight Qwen model, downloaded more than 3 billion times and used by firms including Airbnb and Uber, contains China-friendly narratives and apparent programmed censorship on sensitive topics. The findings raise fresh questions about relying on Chinese open-source models globally.

items.headline: Alibaba, ByteDance and Zhipu AI named to Time's AI list
items.summary: Time magazine included Alibaba, ByteDance and Zhipu AI on its first list of the 10 most influential AI companies of 2026, SCMP reports. The recognition highlights how far Chinese AI developers have advanced in models, consumer assistants and enterprise tools despite US chip export restrictions.

items.headline: Huang: AI 'doomsday narratives' from rivals make no sense
items.summary: Jensen Huang said claims that AI could end the world by 2030 are baseless, calling such warnings from other AI leaders 'irresponsible' and suggesting they have 'ulterior reasons' for making them. Huang maintains Nvidia can move fast on AI while still treating safety as 'paramount.'

items.headline: Musk returns to Trump administration for Pentagon AI study
items.summary: Elon Musk is co-leading a Pentagon study on AI and modern warfare after returning to an advisory role with the Trump administration, euronews reports. His renewed government role comes as the White House pushes to centralize federal AI policy through new oversight bodies.

items.headline: UAE's Sharjah forum to explore AI for government services
items.summary: The Sharjah Investment Forum will examine how AI can transform government operations and investor services, Gulf Today reports. The event reflects the UAE's continued push to position itself as a regional hub for applying AI across public administration and finance.

items.headline: AI megadeals lead this week's biggest funding rounds
items.summary: Personal AI assistant startup Instinct raised $1 billion in a Series C round at a $10 billion valuation, while AI agent platform Temporal Technologies raised $550 million at a $12.55 billion valuation, Crunchbase News reports. The rounds show investors still pouring money into AI despite broader market caution.

items.headline: India approves 13 projects to tackle AI deepfakes and bias
items.summary: The IndiaAI Mission's Safe & Trusted AI pillar has greenlit 13 responsible-AI projects at academic institutions covering bias mitigation, deepfake detection, privacy-preserving AI and explainability, per a government press release. The push aims to build citizen trust in AI ahead of India's AI Impact Summit 2026.
items.source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India

items.headline: Gujarat hosts AI governance conclave ahead of India summit
items.summary: The IndiaAI Mission and the Gujarat government co-hosted a conclave on using AI for good governance, part of preparations for the India AI Impact Summit 2026, The Tribune reports. The event focused on how state governments can responsibly deploy AI in public administration.
